== Description ==

[[Paul Coggins]] (right, black “311” cap, plaid shirt, name tag, looking at a phone), [[Matt Thornton]] (mid-back, tan Rebel starbird cap, full beard), and [[Joe Horbey]] (left, dark denim shirt, chevron mustache, longer brown hair) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
